provenance.l: Philae — separated from Rosetta 08:35 UTC 12 Nov 2014, first touchdown at Agilkia 15:34 UTC SCET after ~7 h; harpoons and hold-down thruster did not fire, it rebounded at 38 cm/s to ~1 km, touched again 17:25 and came to rest at Abydos 17:31 (ESA, Wikipedia).
